description: On the current tip (E090 code), change only the conv-filter Muon peak lr from 0.24 to 0.28 through its 0-d tensor. The head keeps its 0.5x multiplier, so its lr scales along, and nothing recompiles. The schedule shape, floor and tail are unchanged. Muon lr was only ever tuned at bs 1024 with ~384 steps on a pre-tail base (E034). The tip now has ~280 steps, mixed batch sizes and a floor-hold tail, so the optimum may have moved up. Decide with an off-seed run on seeds 3-10 against the tip's distinct mean, plus two scored runs.
